what: S5: workers built two versions of ip hashing, photo upload and the submit form (ip-hash.ts/photo-upload.ts/SubmitForm.tsx vs inline hmacIp/storePhoto and the S4 step form). The wiring ticket used the inline ones, leaving the better-validated modules unused.
rule: Before a build ticket creates a module, check whether the stage already owns one for the same job; a wiring ticket must use the existing tested modules, not write parallel ones.
fix: Scope split: list existing modules per requirement in each ticket's context and forbid new files that duplicate them; integration tickets name the modules they must import.
